title: AI Conscience Revocation List (v1)
description: A signed, structured list of revoked attestations and/or intermediate keys. The signature is a detached Ed25519 signature over the canonical form (keys sorted, signature removed, no whitespace). Attestation-level revocations are signed by the intermediate key; intermediate-level revocations are signed by the root key. signed_by_fingerprint tells the verifier which key to check. No personal data appears in any entry.

issued_at.description: When this revocation list was issued.

id.description: The revoked attestation reference (UPD-YYYY-NNNN) or intermediate key fingerprint (16 hex).

signed_by_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the key that signed this list — the intermediate (for attestation revocations) or the root (for intermediate revocations).

signature.description: Base64 detached Ed25519 signature over the canonical form of this document.
